verdict.rationale: Authenticator products can plausibly expose developer APIs, so this axis applies. However, the evidence contains no documented versioned API or API deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The community note about autofill being discontinued concerns a product feature, not an API deprecation policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
